name: Saṃskṛtam — Sanskrit from the script to the Gītā
description: A complete standalone Sanskrit course: Devanagari from zero with IAST throughout, Classical Sanskrit grammar taught with traditional Pāṇinian terminology, a sandhi trainer, a dhātu lab, spaced repetition, morphology tables, a graded reading room — and a final epic stage ending in a guided First Gītā Reader.
